rounds.text: The business is demonstrating explosive operational acceleration, evidenced by a trailing twelve-month compounded sales growth of 25% and a staggering 161% compounded profit growth [E16, E19]. This fundamental strength is translating directly into pricing power and margin expansion, with quarterly operating margins reaching 20% in March 2026—a three percentage point improvement over the year-ago period [E25]. This profit generation is backed by high-quality cash flows, as operating cash flow reached Rs 18 Cr in March 2026, achieving a 1.50x cash conversion rate where profits are fully backed by cash [E28, E29]. Market participants are severely under-appreciating this momentum, ignoring that insiders are heavily backing the future with promoters increasing their stake to 74.82% [E35]. Furthermore, technical strength is undisputed, boasting a relative-strength rating of 100 against the Nifty 500 alongside a price sitting above both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E44, E45]. Conceded: free cash flow sits at Rs -8 Cr in March 2026 and borrowings have increased to Rs 25 Cr [E30, E33].
